description: This file contains functions and type definitions for handling simple completion models, including resolving models, preparing models with API keys, and executing completions within an agent-based system. It manages external dependencies, model resolution, API key handling, and completion execution.

classes.name: SimpleCompletionAuthStorage
classes.description: Type defining storage for runtime API keys, with a method to set API keys for providers.

classes.name: CompletionRuntimeCredential
classes.description: Type representing runtime credentials including API key and optional base URL.

classes.name: PreparedSimpleCompletionModel
classes.description: Type representing either a successfully prepared model with auth or an error message.

classes.name: AgentSimpleCompletionSelection
classes.description: Type representing the selection details for an agent's model, including provider, model ID, profile ID, and agent directory.

classes.name: PreparedSimpleCompletionModelForAgent
classes.description: Type representing the result of preparing a model for an agent, including selection, model, and auth info or an error.

methods.name: resolveSimpleCompletionSelectionForAgent
methods.description: Resolves and returns the model selection details for a given agent, based on configuration and optional model reference.

methods.name: setRuntimeApiKeyForCompletion
methods.description: Sets the runtime API key for a model, handling special cases like GitHub Copilot, and returns runtime credentials.

methods.name: hasMissingApiKeyAllowance
methods.description: Checks if missing API key mode is allowed based on configuration.

methods.name: prepareSimpleCompletionModel
methods.description: Resolves and prepares a completion model with API key handling, returning either a model with auth or an error.

methods.name: prepareSimpleCompletionModelForAgent
methods.description: Prepares a completion model for a specific agent, resolving model selection and handling errors.

methods.name: completeWithPreparedSimpleCompletionModel
methods.description: Executes a completion using a prepared model and authentication, passing context and options.
